summary: 7-phase implementation plan created for five-primitive propositional refactor. Phases: (1) Foundations axiom abbrevs and HasAxiom* typeclasses, (2) Formula type and semantics with and/or constructors, (3) ND system overhaul removing botE and adding 6 new constructors, (4) Hilbert axiom extension and bridge files, (5) ND-Hilbert equivalence bridge, (6) Metalogic soundness and completeness, (7) External embeddings and CI verification. Total effort: 12 hours. Fully sequential dependency chain.
